paragraphs.text: The RP apprised the Committee that as per the statement submitted before the Hon’ble NCLT Indore Bench the corporate debtor contended that the company’s performance deteriorated day by day by the end of the financial year 2002 and the company committed defaults in the payments and became a sick industrial undertaking. A reference under the Sick Industrial Companies (Special Provisions) Act, 1985 was made by the Company to the Board for Industrial and Financial Reconstruction (BIFR) and vide order of 21.12.2005, the company was declared a “sick company” and the process of rehabilitation was also started.
